name: What steps should I take if I find sewer water in my crawl space?

mainEntity.name: What steps should I take if I find sewer water in my crawl space?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you find sewer water, first ensure everyone evacuates the immediate area and avoid contact with the water. Turn off your main water supply if the leak is from a pipe, and shut off electrical power to the affected zone if safe to do so. Then, contact a professional emergency restoration service immediately. Do not attempt cleanup yourself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evacuate the area, avoid contact with water, turn off water and power if safe. Immediately call a professional emergency restoration service; do not attempt cleanup yourself.
